Help & policies

Support & billing help

Help with your plan, account, or subscription.

Contact Robert Soliday

Email rtsoliday@gmail.com for technical help, billing questions, or privacy requests.

For a technical issue, describe what you were trying to do, the error message, and your browser and device. For billing, include the sign-in method you used and a receipt or invoice reference if available.

Do not send passwords, verification codes, full payment-card details, account statements, or your retirement backup. We can usually start troubleshooting without your financial assumptions.

Manage or cancel a subscription

  1. Open Plans & billing.
  2. Sign in with the same ChatGPT or Google account used to subscribe.
  3. Select Manage billing to open Stripe’s billing portal.
  4. Choose cancellation and review the effective date and confirmation shown by Stripe.

Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. Signing out, clearing browser data, or deleting a scenario does not cancel a subscription. If you cannot access the portal or cancellation option, email support for help.

Pro access follows the subscription’s active status. The portal shows when a cancellation takes effect. Cancellation does not erase scenarios saved in your browser.

Refund requests

Contact rtsoliday@gmail.com with your receipt or invoice reference and the reason for your request. Refund requests are reviewed individually; submitting a request does not guarantee a refund.

Canceling renewal does not automatically refund an earlier payment. This policy does not limit any refund rights that apply by law.

Restore Pro or a saved plan

Pro belongs to the account used to subscribe. Use that same sign-in method to restore access. Separate Google and ChatGPT accounts share a subscription only after you explicitly link them. If both accounts have subscriptions, contact support before linking.

Your retirement scenarios are stored in each browser, separately from your subscription. Signing in on another device does not transfer plans. Use Reports & backup → Export JSON, then import that backup on the other device. Import replaces the plans in that browser, so export its existing plans first. Support cannot retrieve scenarios cleared from browser storage without a backup.
